Preregistration — earworm-fundamental-observation-repair-v1

Execution revision `dd4fbea06485bd00117e9340a83a8844859869c5`. No held-out stimuli/results generated or exposed.
Protocol SHA256 `adf31d13da28ff9cd05a50f8d2c57b7b70c917b3640e311a50f39663a1edea41`.
Freeze SHA256 `db77d75c1fceca99583ec610cdc40af2e01bebd08d4871978fc298c68319394a`.
Execution code SHA256 `ddcd47bebfb6475b89964cdaf040d5dfc72961bf353ca6df0cb8913f642ee2ab`.
Frozen model SHA256 `2eded733c011ac586dda30432c551773bcf70a731e185176730d04b86ad429ec`.

40 fresh normalized motif groups, 8/8/24 splits; 352 development/calibration streams consumed including probes, 528 reserved for one evaluation, total880. Selected NSDF periodicity threshold .85 on development; unchanged PR8 primary retrieval code/context/cutoff/probability parameters. Calibration fits nothing. Both adapters receive identical streams; all baseline adapter labels explicit, transition orders1–3 included.

Absolute probability bins -48..72 semitones relative to A220 plus unknown prediction; known unavailable/out-of-range truth cannot become correct unknown. Positive-infinite logloss serializes as +Infinity. All six preregistered scorer edge tests pass. Pure/fundamental octave-safety guard and resource/causal controls frozen. 5000 group bootstrap resamples, seed2026092020, inverted-CDF quantiles, Bonferroni intervals across three changed-cell contrasts. Fractional-factorial limitations declared, including order interaction alias and pure/fundamental subtype alias.

Protocol, frozen grids/config, source and scorer tests are in `experiments/fundamental-observation-repair-v1/`; the local execution commit will be included in the one complete successor. One frozen evaluation, then publish A/B/invalid result and stop for review. No follow-on study here.
